Security

CIS benchmarks, Pod Security Admission policies, and compliance.

Create Template
CIS Scans
PSA Templates
Security Policies

What is Pod Security Admission (PSA)?

PSA is the built-in Kubernetes admission controller (the successor to PodSecurityPolicy) that enforces the three Pod Security Standards on a per-namespace basis. A template defines which standard applies in each of three modes; it only takes effect once you assign and apply it to a cluster from the Security Policies tab.

STANDARDS (LEVELS)

Privileged
Unrestricted — no policy applied. For trusted/system namespaces or to opt out of PSA.
Baseline
Minimally restrictive — blocks known privilege escalations while staying broadly compatible.
Restricted
Heavily restricted — follows current pod-hardening best practices. Recommended for production.

MODES

Enforce
Rejects pods that violate the standard at admission time.
Audit
Allows the pod but records a violation in the audit log.
Warn
Allows the pod but returns a user-facing warning to the client.
